description: React component for user profile page with editing capabilities, including sections for personal info, skills, social links, experience, and education.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Handles change in input fields, updating the editData state.

methods.name: handleSocialChange
methods.description: Handles change in social link input fields.

methods.name: handleSkillChange
methods.description: Handles change in skills input, splitting comma-separated skills into array.

methods.name: handleExperienceChange
methods.description: Updates experience data at specified index and field.

methods.name: handleEducationChange
methods.description: Updates education data at specified index and field.

methods.name: addExperience
methods.description: Adds a new empty experience entry.

methods.name: addEducation
methods.description: Adds a new empty education entry.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes experience entry at specified index.

methods.name: removeEducation
methods.description: Removes education entry at specified index.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves updated profile data via updateUserProfile and handles UI state.
